remarks: Single Family 5 bedroom 2 bath ranch home sits on 0.4 acres in the Town of Portville.  You will enter from the front porch into a country style foyer with plenty of closet space for outdoor gear and wear.  The spacious living room has a large bay window overlooking the valley.  The fall colors will be exceptional.  Off of the living room you will find five large bedrooms.  The Primary full bath is spacious and awaiting your decoration and relaxation. The front bedroom has an attached full bath with shower. The attached garage was a 2-car garage but now is enclosed for storage.  It could be opened back up and made into a 2-car garage, if needed.  There is a side entry that goes into the kitchen dining area combo.  Wide open space for entertaining.  The partial basement houses the water heater and a offers plenty of room for storage.  There is a first floor utility/laundry room, also with plenty of storage.  This home needs a lot of work and your imagination will bring the home back to life.  USE CAUTION when stepping in the enclosed garage area as the roof is leaking and weak.  Also, the floors will be marked with caution tape due to weakened flooring.  PLEASE DO NOT WALK those areas.   All offers to be made on Propoffers.com by your agent only.   The property is being sold AS IS WHERE IS and will make no guarantees as to the condition of any aspect of the home.
